newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sydkraft wants full nuclear compensation.
newsitem.headline: Sydkraft wants full nuclear compensation.

text.p: Swedish power producer Sydkraft AB, hit by the government's decision to close two nuclear reactors, said on Friday it would demand compensation for lost power production in the form of electricity from the state.
Sydkraft said it would consider legal action to obtain the compensation if necessary.

"Sydkraft must be fully compensated for a future plant closure and compensation should take the form of electricity capacity which will give the same amount of electricity production that can be produced at the Barseback plant under present circumstances," Sydkraft added.
The company said Managing Director Goran Ahlstrom would negotiate with the Swedish government on compensation.
The government said earlier this week it would close the twin-reactor Barseback nuclear plant near Denmark as the first step in its plan to get rid of all nuclear power plants.
